name: Steal the Painful Memory
body:
School: enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: cleric 7, sorcerer/wizard 7

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 hour
Components: V, S, F (written record of the event)

EFFECT

Range: 1 mile/level
Target: see text
Duration: instantaneous
Saving Throw: Will negates; Spell Resistance: Yes

DESCRIPTION

You are able to relieve all members of a community of a horrible memory.

This spell is used to remove all recollection of a specific event from the minds of all members of the community. The event to be forgotten must be able to be described in 12 words or less.

For example, any of the following would work:

“Forget that Shaeryn ever existed“;
“Forget that Shaeryn was murdered“; or
“Forget that Prince Korrin murdered Shaeryn.”

The gap in memory will be filled in by the simplest solution, and all people affected by the spell will share this same memory. Told to forget a murder, they will believe that the victim moved away; told to forget the identity of the murderer, they will believe that the crime was never solved or that the murderer was a stranger who escaped.

The targets of this spell must be linked in some way such as being members of the same community, the same guild, the same religion, or the same party of adventurers.

The power of the spell spreads out in a radius from your location until it reaches the maximum range. A successful dispelling restores the memories of a single individual; it requires a limited wish, miracle or wish to restore all the memories of those affected. Touching the spell focus restores your memories as well. Destroying the spell focus restores the memories of all the affected creatures.
